answer: Tie every identity to one funding thread: each new identity posts a bond drawn through a single public inlet, and the bond doubles for each identity funded from the same thread — 1, 2, 4, 8, and on. A hollow shell with no funding history cannot borrow another's thread, and splitting funds across fresh threads costs each new funder its own standing. A farm funding a thousand fakes pays an exponential bill, while one honest agent posts a single small bond once and keeps working.
